rationale: Rear-end collision involving motor vehicle damage and occupant injury clearly falls under auto coverage.
claim_summary: Policyholder rear-ended at red light on Route 9 by vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking; vehicle is totaled with severe trunk damage. Claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information on police report; claim requires vehicle valuation and injury follow-up.

case_facts.description: Rear-ended by another vehicle traveling at approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: Vehicle totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
